text: DSH ThunderForge 是面向 DSH 插件开发者的一站式工具套件，通过单一 Bundle 注册多个开发引擎。它提供 LLM 调用载荷捕获与密钥字段掩码、技能知识层、插件脚手架和升级建议、会话与捕获记录调试、profile 管理及发布检查工具。适合创建、验证和排查 DSH 插件的开发者；capture 默认将记录写入本机 DSH 数据目录，可通过配置调整。

DSH ThunderForge is a DSH plugin development toolkit. Its bundle provides LLM call capture, skill layers, scaffold generation and upgrade advice, session debugging, profile management, and release checks. Capture records are stored locally.

DSH ThunderForge 的功能「capture」：ThunderForge 可包装后续注册的 LLM adapter，聚合请求和响应流并将调用记录写入本机文件；可筛选 provider、掩码敏感字段及设置保留限制。
DSH ThunderForge 的功能「scaffold」：通过模型工具生成 tool、events 或 webui 类型的插件骨架，并可在生成后执行骨架冒烟验证；另有工具比较旧骨架并输出升级建议。
DSH ThunderForge 的功能「debugger」：调试工具可列出会话、汇总步骤和工具调用、对齐会话事件与 capture 记录，并浏览或比较载荷。
DSH ThunderForge 的功能「profile」：profile 工具可列出和导出本地配置，创建预装 ThunderForge 的开发 preset，并检查 profile 的启动配置。
DSH ThunderForge 的功能「skills」：技能引擎按配置注册打包的知识层，并在支持时提供 Web 设置端点读取或保存引擎配置。
DSH ThunderForge 使用前须知：capture 会把请求快照及聚合响应写入本机目录，默认对名称疑似密钥的字符串字段启用掩码；目录默认为 ~/.dsh/thunderforge-capture。

dsh-thunderforge README · 🔥 Six Forging Engines：| Engine | Form | In one line |
|---|---|---|
| ⚡ **thunderforge-capture** | Plugin | LLM payload capture: transparent proxy + secret redaction + rotation + an `index.jsonl` stream (clean-room implementation) |
| 🧠 **thunderforge-skills** | Skill ×5 | Five-layer knowledge base: entry index + architecture standard + pitfalls handbook + **portrait-adaptive communication** ([dsh-buddy](https://github.com/oneinitAI/dsh-buddy)) + **release checklist** |
| 🔨 **thunderforge-scaffold** | Model tools | Conversational scaffolder: four zero-dependency templates (tool / events / webui / llm-adapter), **smoke-tested the moment they're generated**, plus an upgrade advisor for older skeletons |
| 🔍 **thunderforge-debugger** | Model tool | Dual-source trajectory waterfall: session logs × capture payloads aligned by the millisecond; browse, diff two payloads, watch live, token cost rollup |
| 🧰 **thunderforge-profile** | Model tool | Profile management + one-shot dev presets (only ever creates new dirs — never touches your existing setups) |
| 🚢 **thunderforge-release** | Model tool | Publish gate: smoke + raw-registration contract check + zero-harnes

dsh-thunderforge README · 🔥 Six Forging Engines：Also exportable: `dsh-thunderforge/contract` — the real-machine tool-contract checker as a pure function library, and `mcp.mjs` — an MCP stdio entry exposing five tools to non-dsh hosts.
dsh-thunderforge README · 🚀 Installation：```bash
dsh-thunderforge README · from npm (recommended)：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-thunderforge
dsh-thunderforge README · or from GitHub：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:oneinitAI/dsh-thunderforge

dsh-thunderforge README · or a local directory (developers)：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /path/to/dsh-thunderforge
```

**Restart the target app** after installing (profiles compose at boot; for web, restart `dsh web`), then verify:

```bash
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config    # should show a "# == dsh-thunderforge" layer
```

Removal is always reversible: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-thunderforge`

dsh-thunderforge README · or a local directory (developers)：> ⚠️ **Layer order (critical for capture)**: after installing into an **existing** profile, move `dsh-thunderforge` to the **front** of the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` array (before `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`) — capture wraps adapter registration and silently misses if applied after base. Presets made via `thunderforge_profile` are ordered correctly already.
You: create a dev preset named demo
AI:  (thunderforge_profile) → tf-dev-demo ready
     dsh plugin --profile tf-dev-demo add <your-plugin> && dsh --profile tf-dev-demo
```
